verified_facts.text: Interlaken lies between Lakes Thun and Brienz, at the foot of the Eiger, Monch and Jungfrau mountain range.
verified_facts.excerpt: Interlaken lies between Lakes Thun and Brienz, at the foot of the Eiger, Mönch and Jungfrau mountain range.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is set amid the mountain scenery of the Bernese Oberland.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Victoria-Jungfrau is a haven of tranquillity amid the glorious mountain scenery of the Bernese Oberland

verified_facts.text: The Spa Nescens covers 5,500 square meters.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Spa Nescens invites you to immerse yourself in 5,500 m² dedicated to holistic wellbeing

verified_facts.text: The Spa Nescens interiors are inspired by a 1940s boudoir.
verified_facts.excerpt: Its refined interiors, subtly inspired by a 1940s boudoir, contrast beautifully with the panoramic mountain views

verified_facts.text: Mountain views can be seen from the spa's outdoor brine pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: the elegant interior contrasts with the rugged mountain scenery visible from the outdoor brine pool

verified_facts.text: Inside, the spa has a pool, steam baths, relaxation rooms, a gym and treatment rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inside, a 20-meter pool, steam baths, serene relaxation rooms, a state-of-the-art gym, and generously appointed treatment rooms

verified_facts.text: The sauna area has a mixed Finnish sauna and steam bath, while the other facilities are separated for women and men.
verified_facts.excerpt: The sauna area features a mixed Finnish sauna and steam bath, while the remaining facilities are thoughtfully separated for women and men.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers better-aging programmes from Nescens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Exclusive better-aging programmes from Nescens promise a holistic approach to well-being.

verified_facts.text: Restaurants and bars include Radius by Stefan Beer, La Terrasse Brasserie, Ristorante e Pizzeria Sapori, Victoria Bar & Terrasse and the Spa Bistro.
verified_facts.excerpt: Radius by Stefan Beer La Terrasse Brasserie Ristorante e Pizzeria Sapori Victoria Bar & Terrasse Spa Bistro

verified_facts.text: The Victoria Bar serves drinks beneath stuccoed ceilings or out on the terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Raise a glass to a perfect mountain experience beneath stuccoed ceilings or out on the terrace

verified_facts.text: The Victoria Bar offers signature cocktails, single malts and champagnes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Awaiting you is an exclusive selection of signature cocktails, single malts and world-class champagnes.

verified_facts.text: Suite categories include a Yash Chopra Suite and a Tower Suite.

verified_facts.text: Junior suite categories include a Nescens Junior Suite.

verified_facts.text: Interlaken offers river rafting, bungee jumping, hiking, biking and golfing in summer, and snowboarding, snowshoeing or tobogganing in winter.

verified_facts.text: Nearby excursions include the Kleine Scheidegg, the Schilthorn with its James Bond Trail, and the Brienzer Rothorn with its steam rack railroad.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover the Kleine Scheidegg, the Schilthorn with its James Bond Trail, or the Brienzer Rothorn and its steam rack railroad.

verified_facts.text: Lucerne, Bern and Zermatt are a day trip away.
